title: Barcelona’s amazing gastronomy
text: We had such a great time on our tour with Sofia. She was warm, super knowledgeable, and the way she mixed the city’s history into the food stops made it feel like two tours in one. We really appreciated how she helped us avoid the touristy places and introduced us to dishes and spots we would never have found on our own. It was relaxed, fun, and by the end we were full, happy, and felt like we understood Barcelona so much better.
author: _lodiel819

title: An Experience to Remember
text: What an amazing experience! I can’t even just call it a tour — it was definitely an experience. Daniel was fantastic and truly went above and beyond. We ate so much delicious food, trying things we hadn’t tasted before as well. He chose excellent places to stop, and the drink recommendations to pair with the food were spot on too.
author: C9446ZQadriank

title: Amazing
text: Very unique and local. A great opportunity to explore the city in the non touristy areas and get your money’s worth.
author: Dom_P

title: Great tour, greatest guide
text: Our guide Horacio was amazing. Very knowledgeable and informative. But, more importantly he was just a lot of fun to be with.
author: Jose_C

title: Great Food and Wine and Excellent Company
text: Horacio was a wonderful guide for this exploration of traditional Barcelona tapas and a variety of Spanish wines.  This is a great way to spend a late afternoon / early evening in a vibrant part of Barcelona.  Highly recommend and suggest requesting Horacio to guide!
author: Joshua_J

title: Horacio was above the...
text: Horacio was above the top. He explained the wine route around Cataluña and the wines we taste where perfect. Great time.
author: Virginia_F

title: Lovely adventure with Brune
text: We dined and drank and talked for hours with our guide. She was delightful and gave us some great tips for things to see in Barcelona.
author: Sharon_F

title: Delicious tapas and wine evening where locals go
text: Brunella was warm and knowledgeable. She organised interesting venues to eat and drink, with delicious choices of tapas, pinchos and wine. She was also a great conversationalist. A very enjoyable evening! Many thanks!
author: Carrie_C

title: Great Guide and Good Food!
text: Simone, our tour guide was fantastic!  She came very prepared, and really thrilled with the restaurant locations, which were off the beaten path in Barcelona.  Fantastic food, and a very knowledgeable guide.
author: Ohiole_O

title: Terrific Tapas Experience
text: We had a wonderful evening for Taverns and Tapas.  Our guide was fantastic, and we especially loved that it was just 4 of us in the group.  Our guide, Mariana, took us to great tapas spots that were all a short walking distance away from each other.  We loved the variety of food and drinks.  We were astounded by the AMOUNT of food and drink.  We left absolutely stuffed.  Mariana was so friendly and knowledgeable -- we made a friend and learned so much.
author: Ann_P
